subject: Final go-live / rollout planning call - scheduling
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Carter <emily.carter@acme.com>, Ben Turner <ben.turner@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final go-live planning - proposed times

Hi Marissa / Dylan,

Thanks for partnering with us on the rollout. We're aiming to schedule the final go-live / rollout planning call to confirm cutover steps, fallback policies, and owners. Attendees on our side will be: 2x platform engineers (Ben, Alex), procurement (Emily), and security (Ben Turner).

Can you confirm availability for a 60-90 minute call? The dates/times that work for us (PST):
- Tue, Mar 23: 10:00 - 11:30
- Wed, Mar 24: 14:00 - 15:30

On the call we want to cover: final cutover sequence, immediate rollback steps, canary / validation checks, owner assignments, and post-cutover monitoring. If you have a draft MOP or runbook, please share ahead of the call.

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform, Acme Corp
[Attachment: acme_internal_notes.txt]

Proposed attendees from Redwood:
- Marissa Cole (AE) — overall program owner
- Dylan Brooks (SE) — cutover owner / runbook lead
- Naomi Feldman (Security) — security reviewer / signoff
- Rishi Malhotra (Infra) — networking & routing owner

I'll attach the current draft MOP and runbook. Dylan, can you add the canary steps and fallback summary? Naomi — can you confirm what security artifacts you'd like before the call?

Attachment: acme_rollout_mop_v3.pdf

Thanks,
